productArea.name: Site administration
productArea.scope: Inspect instance configuration and diagnostics, monitor tasks and queues, and search, sort, or manage administrator user, organization, and repository inventories. Package management, webhooks, Actions, and changing authentication details are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Site Administration from the account menu to inspect the instance dashboard.
Choose Configuration to inspect instance settings.
Open Configuration settings and inspect the grouped settings, including Open with editors.
Choose Repositories under Code Assets to inspect its inventory, search, sorting, and management controls.
Choose User Accounts to inspect administrator user search and management.
Choose Organizations to inspect the administrator organization inventory.
Choose Monitoring then Statistics to inspect runtime metrics.
Choose Monitoring then Cron Tasks to inspect scheduled tasks and their controls.
Choose Monitoring then Stacktrace to inspect traces and the diagnosis-report download.
Choose Monitoring then Queues to inspect queue state and controls.
Choose Monitoring then Performance Trace to inspect tracing controls.
